notes.title: Fall Update Devlog
notes.content:
New seasonal update: Autumn based thingys

Just like for Halloween, we have a new UI theme, new companies, and market events to match the season.

Happy Thanksgiving everyone, and if you are looking to play something over break- this update is for you!

Cheers

Change Log:
UI theme
Line graphs
Background music
Seasonal companies
Seasonal market events

notes.title: Halloween Update Devlog
notes.content:
[b]Happy Halloween![/b]
Here's a quick rundown of what's new:

[b]Stock Ticker[/b]
I added a new stock ticker at the bottom of the main screen. This is a good way of keeping up with changing prices for each company over the course of the game.

[b]New Companies[/b]
New Halloween themed companies have been added and can be recognized by the pumpkin icon located beside the name. Hope you guys enjoy these!

[b]Market Events[/b]
New Halloween themed events that impact the entire stock market. This is a feature I always wanted in the game, and adds challenge to playing the market because in addition to company specific news stories, market events will also impact the stock prices.

[b]Steam Sale[/b]
During the Halloween Steam Sale our game is 40% off!! The sale ends soon so pick it up here if you're interested.

[b]UI changes/improvements and Halloween Theme[/b]

notes.title: Version 2.0 Changelog
notes.content:
Increased time in-between news stories
News stories and an immediate and a lasting impact on stock prices
News stories open company's info/graph when clicked
Added purchase shortcuts for minimum and maximum quantity
Added slider for setting order quantity to a percentage of available funds
Added incremental adjustments to stock ordering: up/down in quantities of 5
Added volume control
Extended length of soundtracks
Added candle graph option for viewing stock prices
Added button to close milestone reward notifications
Fixed incorrect title on random event notifications
Added cash total below Account Value
Added quantity owned to buying/selling panel
Fixed bug that allowed purchase of 0 stocks
Fixed stock purchases stacking in reverse order in history section
